name: expense-api

dependencies.name: expense-db
dependencies.description: Stores employees, expense claims, line items, approvals, and export batches.

dependencies.name: receipts-store
dependencies.description: Stores uploaded receipt files (image/PDF) attached to expense claims.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates signed-in caller tokens issued by Thunder and resolves employee/manager/finance role for authorization.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: Sends transactional email notifications via SendGrid on claim submission (to manager) and approval/rejection (to employee).

config.description: SendGrid API key used to authenticate outbound email sends.
Verified sender email address notifications are sent from.

description: Ballerina REST API owning expense claim lifecycle: submission with receipt upload, manager approval/rejection, and finance's approved-but-unexported list and CSV/Excel export. Enforces single-level manager approval and marks exported claims to prevent double export. Does not integrate directly with any payroll provider — export is a downloadable file only.
